Its definition grows StaticCallees(main), dirties InputDemand(main) and Recursive(main), and wakes SeedRoot. Both readiness runs and the uncaused run belong to SeedRoot(root 0). The uncaused run has explicit settled-fact wake evidence, but the replay classifies propagated dirty movements absent from changed as causing nothing. Thus uncaused classification alone does not prove unscheduled work. The PR updates the transport test total 399 -> 410 but leaves CLI causal pins unchanged. Repair must reconcile actual scheduling/finality and replay attribution, preserve zero-uncaused coverage, update exact attributable pins and explanatory docs, and pass the full affected CLI target. Do not merely weaken the zero-uncaused assertion. Related general authority work: fz-kdt.46; existing readiness documentation finding: fz-kdt.180. Diagnosis only so far; no source changes.
